{"program":"domain(person,[holly,coraline,mae,sexy]).
% Holly is not hard-working.
axiom(s1,not(hard_working(holly))).
% If Coraline is either charismatic or talented (but not both), then she is successful.
axiom(s2,rule([xor(charismatic(coraline),talented(coraline))],successful(coraline))).
% Mae is not ambitious.
axiom(s3,not(ambitious(mae))).
% For Mae, being passionate and being selfless are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s4,xor(passionate(mae),selfless(mae))).
% Anyone who performs solo either commands attention or has stage fright (or both).
axiom(s5,rule([performs_solo(X)],or(commands_attention(X),stage_fright(X)))).
% Holly either has stage fright or is charismatic, but not both.
axiom(s6,xor(stage_fright(holly),charismatic(holly))).
% If Holly is successful, then she is both hard-working and passionate.
axiom(s7,rule([successful(holly)],and(hard_working(holly),passionate(holly)))).
% If Mae faces criticism, then she gets nervous and feels sensitive.
axiom(s8,rule([faces_criticism(mae)],and(nervous(mae),sensitive(mae)))).
% If Mae speaks in front of a crowd, then she is either confident or gets nervous, but not both.
axiom(s9,rule([speaks_in_front_of_crowd(mae)],xor(confident(mae),nervous(mae)))).
% Mae faces criticism.
axiom(s10,faces_criticism(mae)).
% If Mae follows her heart, then she either puts others first or is selfless (or both).
axiom(s11,rule([follows_heart(mae)],or(puts_others_first(mae),selfless(mae)))).
% Mae is either ambitious or selfless, but not both.
axiom(s12,xor(ambitious(mae),selfless(mae))).
% Sexy faces criticism.
axiom(s13,faces_criticism(sexy)).
% Holly either performs in public or sings alone.
axiom(s14,or(performs_in_public(holly),sings_alone(holly))).
% For Sexy, being passionate and being selfless are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s15,xor(passionate(sexy),selfless(sexy))).
% If Mae loves music, then she has charisma and performs in public.
axiom(s16,rule([loves_music(mae)],and(charismatic(mae),performs_in_public(mae)))).
% If Coraline performs in public, then she either has stage fright or is confident, but not both.
axiom(s17,rule([performs_in_public(coraline)],xor(stage_fright(coraline),confident(coraline)))).
% If Mae is either charismatic or talented (but not both), then she is successful.
axiom(s18,rule([xor(charismatic(mae),talented(mae))],successful(mae))).
% If Coraline faces criticism, then she gets nervous and feels sensitive.
axiom(s19,rule([faces_criticism(coraline)],and(nervous(coraline),sensitive(coraline)))).
% Holly speaks in front of a crowd.

% Mae is not hard-working.
axiom(s21,not(hard_working(mae))).
% If Mae is successful, then she is both hard-working and passionate.
axiom(s22,rule([successful(mae)],and(hard_working(mae),passionate(mae)))).
% Mae speaks in front of a crowd.
axiom(s23,speaks_in_front_of_crowd(mae)).
% Holly is either ambitious or selfless, but not both.
axiom(s24,xor(ambitious(holly),selfless(holly))).
% If Mae performs in public, then she either has stage fright or is confident, but not both.
axiom(s25,rule([performs_in_public(mae)],xor(stage_fright(mae),confident(mae)))).
% Mae does not sing alone.
axiom(s26,not(sings_alone(mae))).
% Mae either performs in public or sings alone.
axiom(s27,or(performs_in_public(mae),sings_alone(mae))).
% Mae either has stage fright or is charismatic, but not both.
axiom(s28,xor(stage_fright(mae),charismatic(mae))).
% If Mae fears failure and meets expectations, then she gets nervous.
axiom(s29,rule([fears_failure(mae),meets_expectations(mae)],nervous(mae))).","query":"labelled_explanation(talented(mae), Status, Package)"}
